pages.title: Upgrade Slots
pages.text: Each printer has $(l)upgrade slots that grow with its tier$() (T3 = 3, T7 = 8). Drop modules into those slots in the GUI, or Shift+Right Click them onto the machine.$(br2)$(item)Speed$(), $(item)Efficiency$(), $(item)RF Efficiency$(), and $(item)Buffer$() modules stack $(l)multiplicatively$() — two Speed modules give 0.8 × 0.8 = 64% print time. See $(l)Upgrade Modules$() for details.
